key_catalyst: Falling 10-year yield (4.36%) plus broad semiconductor rally driving Nasdaq 100 to record highs
reasoning: Today's session was broadly risk-on: the 10-year yield fell 6bp to 4.36%, chip stocks rallied (ARM +3%, AVGO/QCOM +2%), and the Nasdaq 100 pushed to record highs with QQQ up +0.61% intraday. The only bearish item—Trump's tariff letters to 150+ countries and a 50% copper tariff—is a low-impact (4) recurring trade-policy theme the market absorbed while rallying, not a novel escalating shock. This is the opposite of the 07-16 chip-led selloff (-1.64%); the semiconductor complex that dragged the index then is now leading it higher.
